summary: Re-tested FINAL bug #1 (success → /transfer/auction). Both fixes APPLIED but BUG STILL PRESENT. Same exact reproduction as iteration_5: tap testID=success-continue → URL flips to /transfer/new within 500 ms and stays there. Same console error captured: 'Cannot update a component (NavigationContainerInner) while rendering a different component (TransferStep2 ./transfer/details.tsx)'. The two attempted fixes (useEffect-based redirect in details.tsx + setTimeout(clearDraft,0) after router.replace in success.tsx) do not address the root cause.

ui_bugs.issue: Fix is incorrectly structured. `useEffect(() => { if (!draft) router.replace('/transfer/new'); }, [draft, router])` is placed AFTER `if (!draft) return null` (lines 29-31, before useEffect at 36-38). This is a Rules-of-Hooks violation (the dev added eslint-disable to silence it). The previous render's useEffect (registered when draft was truthy) still re-runs when deps change to [null, router] — firing router.replace('/transfer/new') as soon as success.tsx clears the draft. Result: identical bounce to /transfer/new.

setTimeout(clearDraft, 0) inside goNext does NOT defer the store mutation past navigation. The macro-task fires before the Expo Router stack actually unmounts details.tsx/recap.tsx, so the store update still propagates into a still-mounted details.tsx and triggers its (broken) redirect effect. Net effect ~ identical to clearing in cleanup.

integration_issues.flow: PIN confirm → /transfer/success (10-digit code 1114382722 displayed correctly) → tap success-continue → expected /transfer/auction with LIVE badge + 90s timer + WS snapshot
integration_issues.issue: Observed: URL is /transfer/new at T+500ms and stays there through T+6000ms. Auction screen never mounts. Reproduced 100% (1/1).

react_native_issues.issue: Conditional hook ordering: `if (!draft) return null;` at line 29 sits BEFORE the `useEffect` at line 36, so the hook list length depends on draft. eslint-disable-next-line was added to bypass the lint error rather than fix the structure.

action_items: Apply the SAME ref-guarded pattern to recap.tsx (currently has the same vulnerability — its useEffect at line 25-29 will redirect to /transfer/new if it remains mounted under success when clearDraft fires).

BETTER: simply delete clearDraft() entirely from success.tsx.goNext(). The draft is not user-visible after success and gets overwritten on the next /transfer/new visit (resetDraft is already called there). Removing the clear closes this whole class of bug without ref gymnastics. The setTimeout(clearDraft, 0) line should be removed.

After ANY of the above, re-run the same E2E: login client@sendbid.app/Client@123! → /transfer/new (CI 100 EUR cash Mariam) → details (fee-2 + Famille + Salaire) → recap → PIN 123456 → success → tap success-continue → MUST land and STAY on /transfer/auction with LIVE badge.
critical_code_review_comments: details.tsx line 35 `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` is a code smell — silencing the lint rule does not make the violation safe; React still tracks the previous render's effect registration, which is exactly what causes the bug.

Both details.tsx (line 29) and recap.tsx (line 28) call router.replace('/transfer/new') from a useEffect that fires whenever draft becomes null — including legitimate post-confirmation cleanup. They need to distinguish 'draft never existed' from 'draft was just cleared after I did my job'.

Generally: in Expo Router stacks, when a forward navigation calls router.replace('/screenA'), the previously stacked screens (recap, details) are NOT immediately unmounted in the web preview — they unmount on the next layout commit. Any effect on those screens that reacts to global state (Zustand) WILL fire before unmount. Treat zustand listeners like still-live subscribers.

rca_of_issue: REPRODUCTION (100%, 1/1 this session, 2/2 across iterations 5+6): tap success-continue → URL = /transfer/new within ~500 ms. Console: 'Cannot update a component (`ForwardRef(NavigationContainerInner)`) while rendering a different component (`TransferStep2 ./transfer/details.tsx`)'. MECHANISM: (1) success.goNext calls router.replace('/transfer/auction'), then setTimeout(clearDraft,0). (2) The setTimeout 0 macro-task fires before Expo Router's web stack tears down details/recap. (3) Zustand store update propagates to details.tsx which is still mounted in the stack. (4) details.tsx's effect [draft, router] re-runs with draft=null and calls router.replace('/transfer/new'), overriding the just-issued navigation to /transfer/auction. (Even though the source code positions the effect after `if (!draft) return null`, React still has a registered effect from the previous render with non-null draft and re-runs it when deps change — that is exactly what fires the redirect.) MITIGATION: see action_items #1, #2, #3. Recommended approach: remove clearDraft from success.tsx entirely (action #3). It is the smallest, safest change.
